experience.title: Software Developer Intern
bullets: Work directly with the founding team to design, build, deploy, and iterate on product features weekly based on user feedback.
Own the browser-side 3D rendering layer end-to-end: parsing STL/OBJ geometry, constructing scene graphs, and managing disposal to prevent memory leaks and session crashes on lower-end devices.
Diagnosed and resolved a cross-device rendering issue by tracing failures to WebGL context limits on mobile Safari and shipping a fallback rendering path.
Re-engineered geometry loading to progressively stream compressed GLTF/GLB assets, removing a blocking loading state from the main product flow.
Designed and shipped production WebGL animation systems using GSAP and custom GLSL shaders.
Built reusable dashboard UI infrastructure with TailwindCSS, Radix UI, WebSockets, SQL, and Supabase.

projects.name: DAWN
bullets: Built a stateful conversational agent with sliding-window memory, context compression, and vector-similarity retrieval.
Designed prompt orchestration adapting response tone and depth to conversation phase.
Built a React interface with real-time SSE token streaming and tooling/trace visibility.
Reduced redundant API calls by ~18% through sub-query caching and output-schema validation before re-prompting.

projects.name: Stranded-Music
bullets: Built authentication, playlist CRUD, real-time playback state, and a custom Web Audio API engine.
Improved initial-load performance with Next.js dynamic imports and lazy loading; Lighthouse performance consistently exceeds 90 on cold loads.
Implemented a responsive PWA with offline queue support using service workers and cached manifests.
